name: Living room
fixed: Painted wood fireplace surround with gas insert
description: Front parlor in an 1890s house. Original scenic wallpaper in dark greens and browns covers the walls up to crown molding. A wall of three double-hung windows. Painted fireplace surround with a gas insert, built-in bookcase beside it. A very large cream U-shaped sectional runs under the windows and wraps the room, cutting off the path to the fireplace. Cherry floor, jute rug.
